name: @pryzm/plugin-siteworks
description: PRYZM — SITEWORKS plugin (C116 / ADR-0384). Roads, parking areas and pedestrian areas as ONE element kind wearing three roles: they differ in what they MEAN, in nothing a geometry pipeline can see. Authored linearly (a centreline + width, the Wall shape) or areally (a ring + holes, the Slab shape), with a thickness that hangs BELOW the finished surface. Geometry math lives in @pryzm/geometry-siteworks (pure).
